summary: Caeneus was a Lapith hero who fought the centaurs at Peirithous' wedding. Originally a woman, he became invulnerable after Poseidon's gift and was buried alive under pine trunks when the centaurs could not wound him with steel.

sections.heading: Mythology
paragraphs: Apollodorus tells the transformation and burial. Homer ranks Caeneus among the mightiest men who ever fought centaurs.
Ovid names five centaurs Caeneus killed at the wedding before the pine-trunk end.
